about: How a second, independent reader's check changed the list of texts in names_hidden_leaks.csv that still identify a brand when brand names are hidden: the first list held rows_read texts; the second reader kept rows_confirmed_unchanged, moved rows_moved_between_kinds to another kind (moved), removed rows_removed (removed), and added rows_added (added), giving the final list.
moved: running_shoes_01: Continental rubber (5 other company to 3 feature)
